name: Sarah M.
quote: Finally a training app that actually understands Hyrox - not just a generic strength app with a different label. The race-prep structure is exactly what I needed.

name: James T.
quote: I've tried six different apps. This is the only one where I feel like the program is actually responding to how my training is going, not just incrementing a spreadsheet.

name: Priya K.
quote: The onboarding picked up on my equipment constraints straight away. First program felt achievable, not overwhelming.

name: Dan R.
quote: The conditioning progression is what sets this apart. My sled push times improved by 15 seconds over 8 weeks. Measurable.

name: Chloe B.
quote: I didn't think I needed an AI training app. Then I hit a PR on week 3 that I hadn't managed in two years of solo training.

name: Mike A.
quote: Set it up on the commute, had a 12-week Hyrox prep programme by the time I got home. The taper week structure is exactly right.

name: Rach F.
quote: Felt intimidated by gym programming. Formai made it simple - it tells me exactly what to do and why the loads are what they are.

name: Tom H.
quote: Told it I only have a barbell and dumbbells. The programme it built was completely sensible - no exercises that need machines I don't have.
